title: Bonemeal to Bone
description: Made too much bonemeal? No worries! This datapack makes it so you can craft bonemeal back to bones
body:
Ever need bones but you don't have any but have like three stacks of bonemeal? Well this datapack solves this obscure problem!

![bonemealtobone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c5265cb48b7b5863b28f7f314e87d979c819f96.png)

By putting three bonemeal anywhere you like in the crafting table will give you a bone!
